what: The smoke graphic fades over 18 seconds, blur 10→16px and opacity .75→0, rising 940px upward and vanishing, repeating endlessly. Through the first 33% it turns 40° on the Y axis and stretches thin to .6 width and 1.2 height. After 8.5 seconds a second identical smoke blooms at an offset spot, so two wisps rise crossing each other — charcoal fire · steamer · coffee steam

options.join: Time when the second stream joins (seconds), default 8.5 — 0 means a single stream only
options.[data-fx-part=wisp]: Smoke graphic (svg·img) — required. The second strand clones it

from.where: index.css .hb-smoke: original .smoke-item steam 18s infinite linear (0% blur 10px·opacity .75·top 340px → 33% rotateY 40deg scale(.6,1.2) → 100% blur 16px·opacity 0·top -600px), with setTimeout 8500 floating .smoke-item--02 at top 340·left 350

note: The original keyframe scale put two values into Y by mistake, which the browser discarded, and the copy carried that over as is — this part applies it as intended (.6 horizontal · 1.2 vertical). It goes from rotateY(0)·scale(1,1) at 0% to 33%, and at 100% there is no transform, so it relaxes back.
